dimensions.name: camera_channel_ordered

dimensions.name: conditional_creation_gate
dimensions.runtime_basis: TestCameraSupportFalseE2E: camera-channel MUST NOT be created when support=false

evidence_refs.expected: Created if and only if cameraSupport == true (probed at cameraAddr or overridden via -force-camera)

dimensions.name: bridge_address_and_config
dimensions.runtime_basis: CameraConfig defaults and env resolution verified

dimensions.runtime_basis: TestCameraProbeBehavior verifies probe success/failure/override logic

dimensions.runtime_basis: Offer payload carries camera_support boolean reflecting probe state

evidence_refs.expected: Dialed dynamically on startup; if dial fails without -force-camera, camera_support is disabled.

dimensions.runtime_basis: TestCameraHandshakeSerialization and handshake receipt on mock bridge

dimensions.name: hal_inbound_event_framing
dimensions.runtime_basis: TestCameraHandlerHALBridgeInteraction parses all 3 inbound events

dimensions.name: start_stop_command_dispatch
dimensions.runtime_basis: Browser client receives exact semantic start/stop actions via DataChannel

dimensions.name: inbound_jpeg_frame_ingestion

dimensions.name: snapshot_cache_ordering
dimensions.runtime_basis: Newest frame updates snapshot cache even when queue drops the frame

evidence_refs.expected: latestCameraJpeg is updated under lock BEFORE selectnbsend into cameraFrameChan

dimensions.name: single_element_queue_capacity
dimensions.runtime_basis: cameraFrameChan allocated with cap=1

dimensions.name: non_blocking_send_semantics
dimensions.runtime_basis: Fast producer does not block when queue is saturated

dimensions.name: jpeg_decode_i420_contiguous_fast_path
dimensions.evidence_basis: CAMERA_CHANNEL_B4_PROTOCOL_SPEC.json (fast_path 3 contiguous memmoves Y, Cb, Cr)
dimensions.runtime_basis: TestI420ContiguousGolden verifies exact contiguous planar byte layout

dimensions.name: i420_row_stride_handling
dimensions.runtime_basis: TestI420StrideGolden verifies conversion with YStride > width and CStride > width/2

dimensions.name: generic_image_rec601_fallback
dimensions.runtime_basis: TestI420GenericFallbackGolden verifies Rec.601 YUV output on RGBA input

dimensions.name: virtual_camera_snapshot_extraction
dimensions.runtime_basis: Mock bridge receives exact original JPEG bytes on VIRTUAL_DEVICE_CAPTURE_IMAGE

evidence_refs.expected: Received VIRTUAL_DEVICE_CAPTURE_IMAGE event from Camera HAL

dimensions.name: camera_pipeline_boundary_assertion
dimensions.evidence_basis: CameraCapture.java bound to physical capture; virtual camera decoupled from @uds_sys_v_
dimensions.runtime_basis: Cross-component source artifact verified and decoupling maintained

evidence_refs.expected: CameraCapture.java is positively bound to the physical-camera capture pipeline. No recovered call/data-flow evidence places CameraCapture.java on the virtual-camera injection path; the recovered injection path is camera-channel -> Agent JPEG decode -> camera TCP bridge.

dimensions.name: deferred_channels_isolation
dimensions.evidence_basis: Deferred channels (ai-command-channel, adb-channel) remain strictly inert
dimensions.runtime_basis: Static scan confirms zero business handlers on deferred channels

dimensions.name: reconstructed_runtime_real_sctp_tcp_e2e
dimensions.evidence_basis: Full standards-compliant Pion WebRTC SCTP DataChannel + TCP mock bridge E2E
dimensions.runtime_basis: TestCameraSCTPTCPFullE2E passes Steps A through O

dimensions.name: defensive_bounded_max_frame_size
dimensions.evidence_basis: Defensive safety bound (10MB) rejects oversized frames before allocation
dimensions.runtime_basis: TestCameraWireFramingDefensiveLimit passes

dimensions.name: camera_bridge_interface_abstraction
dimensions.evidence_basis: CameraBridge / CameraBridgeDialer interfaces decouple network transport for testing
dimensions.runtime_basis: Dialer injection verified across unit and E2E tests

dimensions.name: camera_semantic_state_machine
dimensions.runtime_basis: Observable state transitions verified in TestCameraHandlerHALBridgeInteraction

dimensions.runtime_basis: ArrayBuffer confirmed as frontend reference, Agent accepts raw binary JPEG bytes
